description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC Controller named 'FeaturedItemsController' responsible for managing featured products in an administrator web interface. It provides endpoints for listing, paging, adding, and removing 'featured' product relationships within a store context.

classes.name: FeaturedItemsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing featured products in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayFeaturedItems
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of featured items, setting up required data for the view.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch paginated list of featured products as a JSON response.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a product as a featured item.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove a product from featured items.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Configures menu attributes for the web view.
